envelope_successor_changes: runtime_plan requires timing_plan_commitment_sha256; every other predecessor field remains required and unchanged
observation_changes: manifest_observation, closure_receipt_observation and closure_evidence_anchor are forbidden rather than fabricated or filled with null
document_schema_scope: All nine predecessor document schemas are retained except the explicit v2 preregistration schema; original schema files and postrun verifier behavior are unchanged.
rules: Verify every document/ledger hash, required signature role, key/trust validity and cross-document/OOB projection with the shared predecessor implementation.
Verify the chronology only through the consumed anchor; never synthesize a future manifest observation to pass the postrun timeline.
Require consumed-anchor observation <= explicit verification_time_utc < grant expiry, envelope expiry and trust expiry.
verification_time_utc is an explicit input to this readonly verifier, not a proof of current time; the future runtime gateway must obtain its own fresh clock.
Timing plan commitment matches its full bytes and the signed v2 runtime plan; the grant and consumption receipt bind the resulting full external-plan commitment.
Recompute runtime_plan_core_sha256 omitting only external_plan_binding_sha256 and timing_plan_commitment_sha256; no other field may be omitted.
Timing plan case order, attempt caps, per-case cap, request/phase timeouts and Provider identity equal the signed runtime/denominator plans.
Artifact-sealing cap is authorized indirectly by the signed timing-plan commitment and remains within the frozen timing schema ceiling.
Timing execution binding extends the plan binding with the signed grant document hash, canonical external consumed-anchor hash and full external-plan commitment.
Return immutable hashes/time only, not task content, public/private keys, decoded documents, runtime bindings or a reusable execution permit.

Current source, same freeze_authority review, independent review digest, first-live/campaign byte equality, durable one-shot claim and actual consumption-origin collection remain separate runtime gates.
